title: guided product-owner elicitation
description: rcf-lite computes, from the readiness object, the ordered set of questions one persona can answer, each with the write-back that answers it, so that a harness can conduct the intent-complete loop without an engineer. Nothing is stored; the loop ends when `levels.intentComplete.ok` is true.
rationale: Spec 2026-10-01 (DEFINE step 3) section 1 pins the loop as harness-driven. rcf-lite supplies the questions, the write-backs and the verdict; the harness holds the conversation. One new read verb `rcf define questions` turns every failing product-owner check into a per-item plain-sentence question carrying its exact write-back; `levels.intentComplete.ok === true` terminates the loop. The engineer register rides the same mechanism with `--persona engineer`.
